persona: .NET developer who builds the company intranet on SharePoint
resumeText:
Vikram Joshi | Pune | vikram.joshi@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Software Engineer, Sahyadri InfoSoft, Pune (2020 - present)
- Built SharePoint Online intranet pages and document libraries for 3,000 employees.
- Developed SPFx web parts in React and TypeScript for news, leave balances and policy search.
- Styled web parts with SCSS modules to match the company brand.
- Called Microsoft Graph API to show users' calendars and Teams memberships.
- Built Power Automate flows to route approval requests from SharePoint lists.
- Exposed leave data to the web parts through ASP.NET Web API REST endpoints.
- Ran weekly review meetings with the HR team and wrote user guides for site owners.

SKILLS
SharePoint, SPFx, React, TypeScript, C#, Power Apps, PowerShell, Azure

EDUCATION
BE IT, Savitribai Phule Pune University, 2020
